text:
MPC ticked up slightly today, continuing a strong rebound from last week's lows—the stock has gained over 11% since November 6th. The recovery is driven by tight refining conditions: refineries are running at 95.2% capacity with diesel and heating oil inventories at historically low levels (103.33 million barrels), while heating oil prices have surged 59% year-over-year, signaling robust demand for refined products heading into winter. This supply tightness props up refining margins, the profit refiners make by processing crude into fuel.

That said, some headwinds remain in the background. Russian crude production has rebounded to 8.73 million barrels per day according to the IEA, pushing global oil markets back toward surplus—a shift that could eventually ease the tight supply picture that's currently benefiting refiners. Oil prices themselves have drifted down over the past week despite the refining strength, suggesting the broader commodity market isn't confirming the same bullish tone.
